cards.art: two frogs shaking hands over a bomb timer
cards.lore: We formed an alliance with the intention of betraying each other.
cards.name: INEVITABLE MUTUAL BETRAYAL
cards.power: Both players reveal their hands. The one with the weakest card must immediately copy the strongest move.

cards.art: laughing hyena holding cards in front, dagger hidden behind
cards.name: IN THE BACK
cards.power: Conceal the dagger until the final moment.

cards.art: rotund walrus setting a scroll on fire with a candle, looking smug
cards.name: THE OATH-BREAKER
cards.power: Words are wind. Contracts are paper. Paper burns.

cards.art: scheming cat in a monster costume eyeing a cake
cards.name: FALSE FRIEND
cards.power: They were only pretending to be your monster to eat your second dessert.

cards.art: raccoon peering over a trash can rim with binoculars, surrounded by conspiracy notes
cards.lore: It's not paranoia if the universe is actually out to get you.
cards.name: PROPERLY PARANOID
cards.power: Check the bottom card of the deck. If it's a Trap, someone nearby is planning...

cards.art: chameleon in a trench coat and tiny fedora studying a dossier
cards.name: SPIES ARE DESPICABLE
cards.power: We hate them for lying. We spy them for the truth.

cards.art: squirrel handing acorns to another squirrel, one marked with a tiny skull
cards.name: BETRAYAL INSURANCE
cards.power: I knew you'd turn on me, so I poisoned your snacks three weeks ago.

cards.art: apologetic porcupine surrounded by startled animals with quills in their backs
cards.name: CHRONIC BACKSTABBING DISORDER
cards.power: It's a compulsion. Like sneezing, but with knives.

cards.art: ambitious eagle in subordinate uniform plotting with a crown visible in its eyes
cards.lore: Standard operating procedure for number twos everywhere.
cards.name: THE STARSCREAM
cards.power: Challenge the current leader. If you win, congratulations. If you lose, congratulations.

cards.art: eager spaniel in a suit nodding violently at a briefcase-holding figure
cards.name: THE YES-MAN
cards.power: Copy the action of the player to your right.

cards.art: magpie presenting someone else's nest as its own to impressed birds
cards.lore: I made this.
cards.name: STEALING THE CREDIT
cards.power: Take a card from the top of the pile. Put it in your hand and announce: 'I made this.'

cards.art: nervous toad in understudy costume holding a crowbar behind a curtain
cards.name: BASTARD UNDERSTUDY
cards.power: Break a leg. Seriously. Have a crowbar.

cards.art: lion in torn suit standing on a toppled throne with a crown slightly too large
cards.lore: Look at me. I am the leader now. Let's get hungry.
cards.name: THE COUP
cards.power: Overthrow the player with the most points. Look at me — I am the leader now.

cards.art: enormous spider controlling a tiny figure on strings above a card table
cards.lore: Dance, little fly. The web is more robust than you think.
cards.name: THE PUPPET MASTER
cards.power: Force another player to make a move on your behalf. Dance, little fly. The web is more robust than you think.

cards.art: cobra with a gavel dissolving two signatures on a parchment
cards.name: I CAN RULE ALONE
cards.power: The partnership is dissolved. Also, you are dissolved.

cards.art: crabs in business attire around a tiny conference table, one eyeing the exit desperately
cards.name: BOARD TO DEATH
cards.power: This meeting could have been an email but also wouldn't get to be alone with you.

cards.art: mole in a hard hat surrounded by stacks of stolen dossiers underground
cards.lore: I'm not digging for worms. I'm digging for dirt.
cards.name: THE MOLE
cards.power: Peek at everyone's hands. Nobody needs to know for another three rounds.

cards.art: fox wearing two ties, one for each team, showing different cards to different players
cards.lore: Pick a side. And then pick a different one.
cards.name: DOUBLE AGENT
cards.power: Play a card that makes someone else win. The bet is: you've already switched sides.

cards.art: nervous pigeon in witness-protection sunglasses speaking into a police microphone
cards.name: THE STOOL PIGEON
cards.power: I sing like a bird. Specifically, a bird who wants a plea deal.

cards.art: skeleton in a suit presenting a forged death certificate to a stunned insurance agent
cards.name: DEAD PERSON IMPERSONATION
cards.power: Reports of my death were somewhat exaggerated — to collect the insurance money.

cards.art: young bird leaving a nest with a tiny suitcase, parent birds watching in shock
cards.lore: Thanks for the food. Goodbye, home. I'm off to ruin my new kingdom.
cards.name: BETRAYAL BY OFFSPRING
cards.power: Give one of your best cards to a player with more than two kids.

cards.art: disappointed hamster parent holding up a report card with a red F to a cowering offspring
cards.lore: I thought you liked this level. Now I'm going to tell you what I really think.
cards.name: PARENTAL BETRAYAL
cards.power: Hand the 'I would have been a better card' to a player with fewer cards.

cards.art: proud swan father presenting a very different-looking cygnet to confused relatives
cards.name: NOT ACTUALLY HIS CHILD
cards.power: He had your eyes. But he has the milkman's book.

cards.art: praying mantis in medieval armour raising a blade against a nearly identical praying mantis
cards.lore: It's a special kind of awful.
cards.name: KINSLAYING
cards.power: Force the player who betrays you first to forfeit their gifts.

cards.art: glamorous black widow spider removing a tiny spy disguise to reveal an enemy badge
cards.name: LOVE-INTEREST TRAITOR
cards.power: Surprise! I was working for the enemy. I hope your ex-boyfriend is OK.

cards.art: deep-sea anglerfish with a glowing heart-shaped lure and a hidden clipboard
cards.name: THE HONEY TRAP
cards.power: It's not love. It's entrapment, predatory mating rituals and a clipboard.

cards.art: penguin in a team scarf walking away as their team loses on a scoreboard
cards.name: FAIR-WEATHER FRIEND
cards.power: I'm with you! Unless you're losing. Good luck, sir.

cards.art: good-natured dog being swatted with a newspaper while holding a just-rescued kitten
cards.name: MISTAKEN FOR BETRAYAL
cards.power: Was trying to save you! Why are you hitting me with a newspaper?

cards.art: golden retriever removing a hero cape to reveal a villain costume underneath, grinning
cards.lore: Being a good boy was boring.
cards.name: FACE-HEEL TURN
cards.power: Switch from 'Good' to 'Evil': All your Healing cards become damage cards.

cards.art: growling wolf mid-transformation, fur softening, holding out a flower instead of fangs
cards.name: HEEL-FACE TURN
cards.power: Switch from 'Evil' to 'Good': All your Damage cards become healing cards.

cards.art: pink flamingo wearing another bird species' plumage, blending awkwardly into a flock
cards.lore: I find their culture superior. Also, the offering is better here.
cards.name: GOING NATIVE
cards.power: Adopt the customs and identity of the player to your left.

cards.art: fat pig in a militia uniform shaking hands with the opposing general while his own army watches
cards.lore: I welcome our new Kayfabizarro overlords.
cards.name: THE QUISLING
cards.power: Help an opponent win a challenge against your own team.

cards.art: enormous wooden cat on wheels being accepted as a gift, tiny armed mice visible through cracks
cards.lore: Beware of Greeks bearing gifts. Also beware of gift-bearing giant wooden Cats.
cards.name: TROJAN HORSE
cards.power: Give a gift card to an opponent. When they flip it, it explodes into cards.

cards.art: enormous mousetrap baited with a glowing trophy card, small paw reaching toward it
cards.lore: It looked delicious. It tasted like a snapped spine.
cards.name: LURED INTO A TRAP
cards.power: Play a high-value card face down. If someone steals it, they win. Or do they?

cards.art: enormous guilty-faced dog doing puppy eyes while surrounded by chewed furniture
cards.lore: Who, me? I'm just a lil' guy. You wouldn't hit a...
cards.name: FALSE INNOCENCE TRICK
cards.power: Claim an accusation. The accuser must apologize and discard a card.

cards.art: ravens at a wedding banquet suddenly revealing weapons under their formal wear
cards.lore: The Red Wedding was more fun until the catering was expunged.
cards.name: NASTY PARTY
cards.power: Call everyone to assemble to your right. The lowest roll is eliminated.

cards.art: two skunks in police interview rooms choosing cards simultaneously through a glass wall
cards.lore: If I talk, we all die. If we both talk, we cook.
cards.name: PRISONER'S DILEMMA
cards.power: Select an opponent. Both choose 'Snitch' or 'Silent' simultaneously. Snitch + Silent = Snitch wins. Both Snitch = Both lose.

cards.art: bear waving a white cloth while winking, cards hidden behind its back, winner's grin visible
cards.lore: White flag? No, that's my tablecloth. I'm going to wipe the floor with you.
cards.name: I SURRENDER, SUCKERS!
cards.power: Appear to lose. Immediately, you win your biggest lost card back.

cards.art: three meerkats in standoff positions each holding a tiny pistol, all sweating profusely
cards.name: RASH EQUILIBRIUM
cards.power: Standoff situation. No one can make a move until someone acts first. Let's stand here and die of stress.

cards.art: owl in chess master pose pushing a queen piece toward an opponent with a knowing smile
cards.lore: I lost the battle to win the war. And the parking spot.
cards.name: THE GAMBIT
cards.power: Sacrifice your best card to a rival to win the game on three previous turns.

cards.art: rat sliding a bag of coins across a table while pointing at an oblivious friend
cards.lore: The price of loyalty is surprisingly affordable in this economy.
cards.name: THIRTY PIECES OF SILVER
cards.power: Sell an ally for 5 resource tokens.

cards.art: elegant cobra in formal wear raising a jewelled goblet with a small skull floating inside
cards.lore: A toast! To your health... or lack thereof.
cards.name: POISONED CHALICE
cards.power: Offer a card to a player. If they accept, they lose a turn.

cards.art: grinning monkey sealing a handshake with one hand, other hand behind back with crossed fingers
cards.lore: It doesn't count if my fingers were crossed. International law.
cards.name: LYING FINGER CROSS
cards.power: Secretly cross fingers and cancel a deal you made earlier.

cards.art: carrier pigeon in a trench coat handing a card under a table to a surprised player
cards.lore: How humble, who uses pay-phones anymore, already gone.
cards.name: BURNER PHONE
cards.power: Communicate secretly. Swap cards under the table.

cards.art: goat with a bullseye target painted on it being pointed at by everyone at the table
cards.lore: It wasn't me! It was the goat! (Also it was me.)
cards.name: THE SCAPEGOAT
cards.power: Transfer all damage you take this turn to another player.

cards.art: line of nervous hamsters in tiny armour marching toward a cannon blast
cards.lore: Their bravery is matched only by their expendability.
cards.name: CANNON FODDER
cards.power: Block an attack by discarding a weaker card.

cards.art: bat messenger in a postal hat being glared at by a furious recipient holding a bill
cards.lore: Bad news is a capital offense.
cards.name: SHOOT THE MESSENGER
cards.power: When a player hands you a card you don't like, discard a card from their hand.

cards.art: horse in an office doorway being handed a glue bottle and a 'Thanks for your service' card
cards.lore: The job is done. And so are you.
cards.name: YOU HAVE OUTLIVED YOUR USEFULNESS
cards.power: Eliminate your own ally's strongest card.

cards.art: chameleon in a sixth ranger suit already showing the villain badge underneath
cards.lore: So. Go Power Rangers. I will win since the opening credits.
cards.name: SIXTH RANGER TRAITOR
cards.power: Join a team. Betray them immediately for bonus points.

cards.art: moth removing a butterfly disguise, dark wings spreading wide, surrounded by shocked admirers
cards.lore: I wasn't shy. I was consuming my rage.
cards.name: EVIL ALL ALONG
cards.power: Reveal your hidden allegiance. Discard your hand and draw 5 new cards.

cards.art: hypnotised rooster in a suit rising from a chair as another player snaps their fingers
cards.lore: When you hear the Drumline, be the Prime Minister.
cards.name: MANCHURIAN CANDIDATE
cards.power: Become 'Sleeper' agent. Take control of another player's next turn.

cards.art: principled-looking pig reaching for a glowing card being dangled by an opponent
cards.lore: I have morals. But I also really like cards.
cards.name: THE CORRUPTIBLE
cards.power: When an opponent offers you any card, you must accept it.

cards.art: noble dog looking up at a cat ally raising a tiny dagger, surrounded by falling rose petals
cards.lore: Then fall, Fido.
cards.name: ET TU, BRUTE?
cards.power: If your best friend attacks you, they instantly win. You die of heartbreak.

cards.art: elderly elephant with a tiny notebook pointing across a table at a nervous mouse
cards.lore: Elephants never forget. And never forgive.
cards.name: THE VENDETTA
cards.power: Target a player who wronged you 6 turns ago. Eliminate their strongest card.

cards.art: dinosaur toys reenacting a heist, tiny T-Rex clearly telegraphing betrayal to a resigned stegosaurus
cards.lore: We knew it was coming. We waited until after dessert.
cards.name: CURSE YOUR SUDDEN BUT INEVITABLE BETRAYAL!
cards.power: When someone betrays you, immediately steal the card they used to do it.

cards.art: donkey pushing another animal out of harm's way, looking satisfied and also somewhat destroyed
cards.lore: I won. But at what cost? ...Fair enough. It was everyone else.
cards.name: REGRETFUL TRAITOR
cards.power: Sacrifice yourself to save another player. Redemption arc!

title: Trust & Betrayal — The 'Trust Me, Bro' Edition
